This dataset contains sixteen (16) scans of the Kootenai Brown Cabin, located at the Kootenai Brown Pioneer Village, Pincher Creek, collected by the Capture2Preserv team on July 26th 2023. The data was collected with the Z+F 5010X and all data was registered in Z+F Laser Control. The scans were exported and converted in to .las format in CloudCompare.
